requirements_summary: Primary workload: internal code search for engineers + surfaced suggestions in IDE
Scale: 100M+ code snippets; embeddings corpus grows by ~5-10M/day during active syncs
Latency SLO: interactive queries <200ms p95; reranking path allowed up to 400ms if cached candidate set present
Throughput: occasional bursts (CI batch jobs) of 5k qps for bulk indexing; steady-state 100-300 qps for interactive queries
Indexing: daily incremental, weekly full snapshot; supports partial reindex for changed repos
Model preferences: open-code models (code-specific embeddings) + ability to plug in reranker (small distilled models for latency)
Routing/fallback: prefer same-region Dedicated, fallback to hosted variant in DR region; require deterministic model version pinning
Operational needs: cost per query reporting, token-level tracing, rollback and canary deploys for reranker models
